players.product: 8-inch and 12-inch specialty foundry: power discretes (super-junction MOSFET, IGBT), embedded and standalone non-volatile memory, analog and power management, logic and RF

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor HKEX announcement: Discloseable Transaction in Relation to the JV Investment (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Third 12-inch fab joint venture (discloseable transaction): on 1 September 2026 Hua Hong, its subsidiary HHGrace Shanghai, Wuxi Municipal Entity II, Hua Xin Fund and a China Development Bank entity signed agreements to convert Wuxi JV III (Wuxi Huahong Grace Semiconductor (Phase III) Manufacturing) into a joint venture that will build and operate the company's third 12-inch wafer foundry production line, with a monthly capacity of approximately 55,000 wafers and a total investment of US$6.95 billion. After completion the Group will hold approximately 51% (25% directly, 26% through HHGrace Shanghai) and Wuxi JV III remains a consolidated subsidiary; the deal is subject to conditions including shareholders' approval.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 55,000 wafers/month; total investment US$6.95 billion; Group stake approximately 51%
